[[File:Holographer_Vendri_DeRalm.png|thumb|right|250px|Duros holographer, Vendri DeRalm]]

'''Holographer''' was a profession. Holographers would specialize in capturing [[holograph]]s for use in various media. One of the most famous holographers was the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bovit Leebo]], who captured the well-known image of [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], which was featured in ''[[Riccix's Revised Basic Holodictionary]]''.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Duros]] holographer [[Vendri DeRalm]] enjoyed exploring unspoiled worlds and became adept at at lining up the perfect shot in 2-, 3-, and 4-dimensions. After he was continually harassed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he was recruited into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
